name: Anthony Von Schloss
concept: Samouraï des rues — maître du kenjutsu
bio:
Héritier d’une famille noble de guerriers allemande, Anthony a été envoyé au Japon pour être formé au **kenjutsu** par un moine. Il a ensuite dérivé vers la pègre de Seattle (mafia, yakuza) avant de devenir shadowrunner.

Combattant au corps-à-corps redoutable, il manie le **nodachi** avec une précision chirurgicale… et un penchant sadique : il prend plaisir à achever les ennemis blessés (*Accompli dans le meurtre*).

### Historique (Foundry)

Anthony von schloss was born in Germany in Berlin. His family is a family of noble warriors possessing acastle. One day, when his family expelled him from the castle (they were fed up with him doing nothing with his days), he decided to go to Japan.
There, he met a monk (Adachi Morinaga), who accommodated him in his temple and mainly taught him how to manage himself. Anthony also learned the art of katana there and some basic knowledge about Kenjutsu. He was fired when the monks realized that Anthony's ideologies were very different from theirs. Indeed, although Anthony had a great ethics and that he used his katana and Kenjutsu to protect the population and the innocent people in general, he took great pleasure in killing his enemies and more particularly in finishing them off in a violent manner when they were wounded and when they implored to spare them. Anthony then went to the nearest airport and requested a ticket completely randomly. He then took the plane and landed in Seattle in the United States.
He spent a few months in the streets hanging out with bad influences like the mafia, the yakuza and other gangsters. Thanks to his skills in combat, he managed to quickly make a reputation and consequently money. Today, after preparing himself physically and in equipment, Anthony made the decision to hire his services and become a shadowrunner. He is just getting ready to begin his first mission.

gmNotes: Volonté 1 et Logique 1 : très influençable, résiste mal à l’intimidation et à la manipulation, mémoire défaillante — à exploiter avec doigté.

name: Jane
concept: Face — adepte sociale, infiltratrice et tireuse d’élite
bio:
Face du groupe et **adepte sociale** : Jane lit les gens comme des livres ouverts, ment sans ciller et se glisse dans n’importe quel rôle. Spécialiste de l’infiltration, elle a aussi reçu une formation de **tireuse d’élite**.

C’est elle qui a amené le job « Kidnapping » via son contact Sophie Winters, et c’est chez elle que la femme secourue a été mise à l’abri. Street Cred la plus haute du groupe.

name: Bricks
bio:
Ancienne **spider de Knight Errant** (sécurité Matrice), Bricks a vu son escouade disparaître membre après membre alors qu’elle traquait des shadowrunners. Elle a **simulé sa propre mort** avec l’aide de son ex-partenaire Rebecca « Windows » Wrought.

Elle fait désormais des runs elle-même pour financer sa recherche : découvrir qui en veut à son ancienne équipe. Officiellement morte, elle vit sous le faux SIN d’**Alexia Harbinger**.

### Historique (Foundry)

Previously a spider for the Kinght Errant.  
Team pursued and captured shadowrunners that had stolen company data.  
Members of the squad started disappearing mysteriously.  
Bricks decided to fake her own death with the help of her best friend Windows.  
Her plan is to complete runs in order to gain the money and networking she needs to find out who is after her and her team.

name: Ank’ Lay
concept: Brute de combat — dernier guerrier de son clan
bio:
Meilleur guerrier de son clan dès l’âge de 11 ans, élevé dans la violence. Son clan a été **anéanti pendant son absence** : il a tout perdu et s’est retrouvé à la rue, sans le sou et sans contact.

*Ne fait plus partie de la table depuis la fin du job « Kidnapping » (son joueur est parti).*

### Historique (Foundry)

S'énerve (trop) facilement si son nom est prononcé un peu vite.  
A tendance à tout régler par la violence.  
Troubles de l'attention (5mn ou plus test étendu test 3 composure).  
En tant qu'oni, et à cause de son nom, a eu une enfance difficile. Au vu de ses qualités et de son milieu, il a rapidement appris que la violence était toujours la meilleure solution. Ce qui en a fait à 11 ans le meilleur guerrier de son clan, capable de réussir les missions les plus dangereuses.  
Son clan s'est fait éliminer il y a peu, pendant qu'il était en vacances. Il n'a pas pu récupérer ses possessions et se retrouve donc à la rue, sans contact, et sans le sou.

name: Christopher Armingstar
bio:
Tall and of a pretty average build man, some grey hair can be seen and a 3 days beard can be seen on the face.  
He as a pretty face but if you are near him you can't shook the feeling of uneasyness like he's not the man he seems to be.  
Addicted to alcohol and to smoking, he spend most of his free time in some bar trying to con some "innocent" bystander.  
As far as his memory goes he always lived with his father, who was working in some shaddy business; Due to his work his dad, and defacto Chris, had to move arround a lot, which led him to had to addapt quickly to new environement, faces, schools. This constant moving arround is what forge his character to be what he's know: quick to adapt, and please the person in front of him. his father being rarely there for him, he hung arround with some shaddy people when he was a teenager leading him rapidly to become quite fond of alchool and smoking, which took him away from the loneliness of comming back to a empty home. After a few years of sweet talking his way arround he quickly understood that having social skills can give you a lot of advantages in life; so much so that you can pretty much live off other people's cluelessness.
